snippet: Just as there is no difference between the real and the unreal in their own nature, so too — this is certain — there is no such difference between the inert and the non-inert.

snippet: But how could they be indistinguishable here, when the existent performs a function (arthakriyā) and the other does not? And yet the thing, in its own self, remains without distinction.
